name: spll
description: SPLL システム（Google Apps Script + clasp）／ SPLL-SYS-BD-001

scripts.test: node tests/harness.js && node scripts/build.js && node tests/sec01.js
scripts.push:portal: npm run build && cd apps/portal && clasp push -f
scripts.push:workflow: npm run build && cd apps/workflow && clasp push -f
scripts.push:admin: npm run build && cd apps/admin && clasp push -f
scripts.push:accounting: npm run build && cd apps/accounting && clasp push -f
scripts.push:all: npm run build && cd apps/portal && clasp push -f && cd ../workflow && clasp push -f && cd ../admin && clasp push -f && cd ../accounting && clasp push -f
scripts.deploy:portal: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.js portal
scripts.deploy:workflow: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.js workflow
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.js admin
scripts.deploy:accounting: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.js accounting
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && node scripts/deploy.js portal && node scripts/deploy.js workflow && node scripts/deploy.js admin && node scripts/deploy.js accounting
